scope: A1 Unit 1 companion content and grading; source books are read-only
completedChecks: all nine actual Unit 1 reference banks remain exactly covered by their lesson sets
all Unit 1 lesson, word-set and activity identifiers are valid and reachable
combining repeated lesson references does not duplicate vocabulary learning identities
every selected word can appear once in an all-words round and is graded independently
choice sets have one correct choice, no duplicate labels, and every wrong choice fails
synonyms do not appear as false distractors or falsely master an unseen bank spelling
capital-letter practice really checks capitals and punctuation while ordinary recall is forgiving
typed sentence construction accepts correct order and rejects reversed words
matching games use one-to-one English and Spanish study pairs
locker codes retain number boundaries and never turn the game into arithmetic
number spellings cover zero to one hundred without accepting teen/tens confusions
all path activities produce real questions; mixed reviews contain vocabulary and grammar
real listening questions point only to existing book recordings with source-key answers
fresh club-card practice uses fictional details and checks fields rather than stereotypes
sessions, selection validation and priority review preserve meaningful learning boundaries
masteryPolicy: Only successful retrieval awards word IDs. Accepted synonyms can be correct without claiming that an unentered bank spelling was recalled; mere viewing never masters an item.
referenceEvidence: Reviewed Unit 1 source snapshot; local authoring book unavailable
limitations: This verifies the curriculum/content layer and grading. Final artwork, integrated UI, backend persistence and published browser checks belong to the app release review.
